title: Framework for developing and evaluating ethical collaboration between expert and machine

bias_targets.methodology: Conducting age-stratified, cross-center evaluations during the calibration phase of multi-modal AI models to develop unbiased detectors for both adults and children.

Using gender-specific digital twins as inputs to transformer models and analyzing attention maps to determine if the models effectively utilize gender differences to improve positive predictive value (PPV) for women.

Evaluating AI-generated medical intervention plans for underrepresented physiological contexts and scenarios (such as pregnancy, aging, and exercise) by testing plan safety, feasibility, and performance metrics against patient-specific digital twin simulators.
